Sam — great chatting earlier. Quick recap and next step: Orbit is focused on reducing per-token cost for batch scoring while keeping 95th %-ile latency under 300ms for interactive queries. You mentioned two priorities: (1) validating model variants we can run with quantized runtimes, and (2) benchmarking your streaming latency over our routing/fallback policy.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML infra engineers (Jonas + Karthik) to review architecture, runbooks, and test plan. Can you confirm who from Orbit should attend (ML lead + infra/sre)?

Windows we have next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-18 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-08-19 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-08-20 16:00–17:30

I attached a short draft agenda and an access checklist for staging. If none of those times work, send a few options and we’ll lock something in. Once we agree, I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief prep doc with commands/keys for the test environment.

Thanks — Sofia
